description: Returns one ready-made move: its block program as JSON, the same program as screenplay text, its length in seconds, what it works on, its settings with units, its page and links. Name it by id (c4c:beh:wave_hello), short name (wave_hello) or page slug. To write your own move, start from one, change it, then validate it. Example: {"move": "wave_hello"}.

move.description: Its id, short name or page slug, as list_moves gives them.

name: get_move
title: Get one move's program and readable text
